About the Workplace team The Workplace Operations team at Trustly is responsible for the environments where our people do their best work, spanning offices across multiple global locations. As a growing function, we're focused on building strong processes, structure, and smart use of technology into everything we do — from office operations and space planning to vendor and landlord relationships. We aim to create workplaces that are seamless, well-run, and genuinely supportive of employees day to day, while continuously raising the bar on how workplace services are delivered across the company. About the role Trustly is seeking a full-time Workplace Coordinator to build the community in our San Francisco office, based at WeWork. You will be the person who knows everyone, connects people across teams, and shapes what it feels like to work here as the office grows. You will also own the day-to-day running of the space, because a strong office culture depends on the basics working well. We are looking for someone creative and open who brings ideas, tries them, and keeps what works. What you’ll do - Build the office community: get to know every employee, introduce people across teams, and make sure new joiners and visitors feel they belong from their first day - Plan and run events and rituals that bring people together, from team lunches and celebrations to company-wide moments, and try new formats to see what works - Own the new hire experience on site (desk setup, access, welcome materials, introductions) so every joiner has a strong first week - Bring Trustly’s culture and values to life in the space, and connect the San Francisco office to our other offices around the world - Listen to employees, gather feedback, and turn it into improvements to how the office runs - Help the office scale: spot what will stop working as headcount grows and build simple, repeatable ways of working, using technology and AI where they help - Be the on-site go-to person for workplace questions, and manage office access (badges, key cards, visitor requests) - Act as the liaison between Trustly and WeWork community and building management (maintenan

WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. As a global leader in Open Banking Payments, we are establishing Pay by Bank as the new standard at checkout, providing unparalleled freedom, speed, and ease to millions of consumers and merchants worldwide. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. If you are driven by a strong sense of purpose and thrive in a dynamic, entrepreneurial, and high-growth environment, join us and be part of a team that’s transforming the way the world pays. ABOUT THE TEAM The Office of the CTPO accelerates all of Product & Technology: faster, clearer decisions, more output per person, and teams empowered to innovate. We sit at the center of how P&T plans, prioritizes and stays aligned with the rest of Trustly, and we increasingly shape how the whole company plans. ABOUT THE ROLE Working closely with the Chief of Staff, you'll run the machinery behind how P&T plans, measures progress and makes decisions stick. You'll work frequently with the CTPO, the executive team and the leaders who run our largest businesses, and you'll help teams across the company plan and execute faster. This role is for someone who can't stand wasted effort. You'd rather ship a one-page answer on Tuesday than a perfect model next month. You build the simplest process that works, automate it, and move on to the next problem.
